newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk contractor Bayindir gets $50mln syndication.
newsitem.headline: Turk contractor Bayindir gets $50mln syndication.

text.p: Bayindir Holding, a Turkish contractor company, obtained a $50-million, three-year syndication loan from an international group of seven banks to finance highway projects, company officials said on Wednesday.
They said the arrangement of the loan, which has an annual interest of 125 basis points over London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), was led by ABN-AMRO Bank.
Other participants are Citibank, Banque-Misr Paris, Chiao Tung Bank (Europe), Demir-Halk Bank Nederlands, Sabanci Bank Plc and The Sanwa Bank Ltd.
They said an agreement for the loan, to be used by the Turkish treasury on behalf of the company, was signed on Monday in London.
